question: On Train tasks with recorded No Skill failure, can the existing same-information Direct versus Conditioned update policies construct useful repairs, and how do frozen candidates behave on independent Selection?
hypothesis: Failure-focused Train provides a concrete repair target for the existing Diagnosis and update policies. Response-conditioned direction, scope and coordination may improve the resulting update relative to ordinary same-information history-assisted revision; identity, no_change and regressions remain valid outcomes.
memory_policy: Reuse the immutable effective historical response snapshot; no relearning or manual rewriting. Scope/limits remain. Selection never enters Diagnosis, Memory, proposal or Editor in this trial.

sampling.selection_basis: Select all two existing complete No Skill Train failures in the prior six-family native check, before candidate construction. This is deliberate failure-focused development sampling, not an unbiased Train success estimate.
sampling.fresh_feedback: Old upstream traces lack the current fixed-Skill provenance schema; replay both selected tasks exactly once through the unchanged fixed-Skill No Skill learning entry. Retain both outcomes in the declared batch, whether fresh failure or success; no replacement/resampling to manufacture failure.
sampling.selection_rule: Keep the six previously declared but unexecuted Selection tasks from operation05, one per family. They are not filtered by No Skill failure; results are unavailable to construction. Sampling rules and prior exclusion remain in the operation05 plan.
sampling.previous_trial_status: no_change; no Selection executed; retained unchanged
sampling.no_test: Do not read Test trajectories or outcomes; no Test execution.
sampling.scope: Historical failure is a selection criterion, not proof of stable task difficulty or current failure. Infrastructure errors stay unknown.

comparison.direct: Ordinary competent history-assisted requirement revision followed by the shared faithful Editor.
comparison.conditioned: Explicit direction/scale/interaction and visible-condition-preserving update rules followed by the same faithful Editor.
comparison.shared: Same current Train evidence, independent serious Diagnosis Plan, complete effective Memory view, output structure, Editor policy and two-call ceiling per arm. Proposal input user messages are byte-identical. Editor effective requirements differ as the intended mediator, historical information does not.
comparison.limitation: This is an exploratory prompt-policy comparison at equal call/request ceilings, not an ablation proving a unique algorithm, numerical optimizer, or superiority over every direct editor. Actual tokens and latency may differ.

freeze: Before Selection bind the complete initial/effective Plans, raw and normalized outputs, actual Skill/diff, questions, historical state, code, protocol, and all construction sources. No post-freeze semantic calls, candidate changes, new selection, retry or refitting.
evaluation_order: Fixed task order with parent/direct/conditioned arm order rotated by task index; at most three actor workers, separate fresh environment per episode.
metrics: native success/failure/unknown per task and arm
steps per task, distinguish completed success from truncation
observed continuation and recovery against frozen questions
all semantic/actor requests, transport attempts, reported tokens, unknown usage
stop_rules: Both preselected historical-failure tasks get one fresh No Skill run. Retain both results; no Train substitution or episode retry after outcomes. Incomplete Train blocks construction.
Diagnosis no_change/need_evidence stops construction honestly. Each proposal/Editor stops on malformed output or needs_revision; the other arm can finish independently.
Only byte-identical inherited watch echoes may be normalized; all raw responses retained. No semantic content repair.
Only released candidate/no_change arms plus Parent can enter Selection; missing arms make the main comparison incomplete.
An infrastructure interruption is unknown, not failure or success. Preserve all requests and costs. No unplanned recovery attempt.
Selection is never learning evidence in this operation; no post-evaluation modification or formal adoption. Test is not used for selection, learning, evaluation or new execution.
scope_change: Only Train selection and the declared episode ceiling change. Diagnosis/Direct/Conditioned/Editor prompts, Memory snapshot, client settings, output schema, Selection task list and stopping rules are unchanged. No efficiency/success-extraction/value-judgment extension.
